name: io.github.myloadcircle/loadcircle-agent-gate
description: Paid MCP: UK company checks, driver compliance, verified PSTN calls. x402 USDC + Stripe MPP.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Free tool: live tool schemas, pricing and supported jurisdictions.

tools.name: verify_uk_company
tools.description: Verify a UK company via Companies House (+ optional FWA compliance). ($0.10)

payment.description: Optional payment: x402 base64 payment payload, or MPP voucher (mpp.v1...). Without it, the tool returns a payment_required challenge.

tools.name: verify_driver_compliance
tools.description: Verify a driver's licence/compliance verdict via Loadcircle RideShield. ($0.15)

driver_id.description: Driver identifier in the fleet system

fleet_reference.description: Fleet reference to scope the check

payment.description: Optional payment: x402 base64 payment payload, or MPP voucher (mpp.v1...). Without it, the tool returns a payment_required challenge.

tools.name: place_verified_call
tools.description: Place a verified PSTN call via Loadcircle CallCircle after E.164 guardrails. ($0.25)

to_e164.description: Destination in E.164; premium-rate prefixes are hard-blocked

caller_purpose.description: Declared purpose of the call (compliance record)

script_summary.description: One-paragraph summary of the call script

compliance_receipt_hash.description: audit_receipt_hash of a prior check to chain (e.g. verify_driver_compliance)

payment.description: Optional payment: x402 base64 payment payload, or MPP voucher (mpp.v1...). Without it, the tool returns a payment_required challenge.
